name: The net maps' own pieces on generated layers
now: Surveyed over 24 areas (issue #505). On layers: CopyBot Comp's claws, BN4's Undernet's flames and the Undernet's and Undernet Zero's fire bowls, cut from the maps' second tile layer with the panel they grip and the panels they draw over (src/map/sides.c), MegaMan drawn behind them as in BN6; the Underground's teal emblems; Aquarium Comp's pillars under its pads, cut from the first layer in the view of the pads' height. The bowls and the bubbles under the pillars' stubs are tile animations the maps' GFXAnim lists write (tiles 726-737 and 1-12; tools/map_anims.py) and run on a generated layer by the game's own scripts.
left: Robot Control's pipes; the other kinds on issue #505.
